subject: Eye
text: Defeating the Eye rewards 3228 Experience and 3228 GP.

evidence.quote: He will give you 3228 Experience and GP, the EXP of course divided amongst the survivors.

subject: Eye
text: The Eye can use Glance to turn characters to stone, which can be blocked completely by equipping a Ribbon.

evidence.quote: He can use Glance and turn you to stone. However, he seldom uses it, and it usually doesn't work anyway. If it's still a problem, equip a Ribbon to block it completely.

subject: Eye
text: Fighting the Eye repeatedly is a fast and safe way to grind to level 50 and reach the maximum amount of 999,999 GP.

evidence.quote: Anyway, this way is quicker and safer than any other way I know to get up to level 50 and get the maximum amount of money, 999,999 GP.

subject: Loot Root
text: The Loot Root sequence gets key treasures early by going to Castle of Ordeal for the tail, skipping Volcano to get FLOATER from Ice Cave, raising Airship, getting CUBE from Waterfall, looting Sea Shrine top floors and B1-B2 after OXYALE, getting SLAB and CHIME, clearing Mirage Tower/Sky Castle and Tiamat, and finally killing Kraken and Kary.

evidence.quote: After you get the canoe, head over to the Castle of Ordeal and get the tail...Skip the Volcano, and get the FLOATER from the Ice Cave...Get the Airship, and buy stuff you need...Pick up stuff from the Waterfall and get the CUBE...Pick up stuff from the top 2 floors of the Sea Shrine, then floor B1 and B2, after getting the OXYALE from the fairy...Learn Lefienish with the SLAB and get the CHIME...Get the stuff from the Mirage Tower/Sky Castle and kill Tiamat...Kill Kraken, then Kary.

subject: Mirage Tower
text: Mirage Tower contains the ADAMANT used to forge Excalibur.

evidence.quote: If you don't want to, head straight to the Mirage Tower to get the treasures there like the ADAMANT for Xcalbur.

subject: Waterfall
text: Entering the Waterfall treasure room triggers a spiked square battle yielding about 4000 GP against combinations of Wizard Mummies, Mummies, Cockatrices, and Perilisks.

evidence.quote: Now, as soon as you enter the treasure room, there will be a spiked square filled with undead monsters. You'll find combinations of mainly WzMummies and Mummies mixed with a couple Cockatrices and maybe a couple Perilisks...Each battle yields about 4000 GP, which will quickly add up to enough to buy at least one Level 8 Magic Spell or another Gold Bracelet.

subject: Waterfall
text: Talking to the robot in the Waterfall rewards the CUBE needed to enter the Sky Castle.

evidence.quote: First, talk to the robot to get the CUBE, which you need to get into the Sky Castle, but you won't need that for a while.

subject: Waterfall
text: A treasure chest in the Waterfall contains the Defense sword, which casts RUSE when used in battle.

evidence.quote: First, there is the Defense sword, which is the third best weapon for the Red Wizard, besides the Sun Sword, and the Masmune, of course, neither of which you have at this point. The Defense sword casts RUSE in battle.

subject: Waterfall
text: A treasure chest in the Waterfall contains the Wizard Staff, which casts CONF in battle and can be sold for 25,000 GP.

evidence.quote: You will also find the Wizard Staff. This is relatively useless, so you can sell it for 25,000 GP. If you don't need the cash, you can keep it, as it casts CONF when used in battle.

subject: Waterfall
text: A treasure chest in the Waterfall contains a Ribbon, an equippable helmet for any class that provides resistance to all elements including poison attacks.

evidence.quote: Now, the grand finale! There's a Ribbon in here! The Ribbon equips as a helmet, accessible to any class...First, it provides resistance to all the elements including poison-based attacks, such as Gas D and Tiamat's POISON.

subject: Oasis
text: The shop at the Oasis sells a BOTTLE for 50,000 GP.

evidence.quote: The guy there will sell you a BOTTLE for 50,000 GP.

subject: Gaia
text: After using the BOTTLE to release the fairy, talking to her in the northeast corner of Gaia rewards the OXYALE.

evidence.quote: Go to the item menu and use the BOTTLE. It will tell you that a fairy popped out, then is gone. Now, go back to Gaia. All the way in the northeast corner of the town, you will find the fairy waiting for you there. Talk to her, and she will give you OXYALE.

subject: Water
text: Waters in the Sea Shrine can deal 90+ damage to a Knight and are weak to Ice spells.

evidence.quote: What little damage you do manage will still be a small chunk out of their high HP. Yet, they have a nasty bite (or however the hell a little swirl can really hurt you), and can easily do 90+ to a well-armored Knight. Use Ice for these little pricks.

subject: Sea Shrine
text: The top floor of the Sea Shrine contains Opal equipment and the SLAB needed to learn the Lefeinish language.

evidence.quote: On the top floor with all the Mermaids (where most of the Mermaids are), you will find the Opal equipment, and the SLAB, which you must give to Dr. Unne in Melmond to learn the Lefeinish language, which will be important later.

subject: Sea Shrine
text: The bottom section of the Sea Shrine contains the Opal Armor, two Light Axes, the Mage Staff, and a Ribbon.

evidence.quote: Now, we head to the bottom. You will find the Opal Armor, as well as 2 Light Axes, the Mage Staff, and a Ribbon.

subject: Light Axe
text: Using Light Axes in battle casts HRM2, while the Mage Staff casts FIR2.

evidence.quote: The Light Axes will be very useful against the undead as they cast HRM2. The Mage Staff will also be good against the undead, as it casts FIR2.
